calls.video_title: A Once in a 100 Year Investment Opportunity Just Started (Felix Nikolas Prehn on Where He's Buying)
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked. Constellation Energy is a profitable power generator with real earnings, real power contracts and a dividend — the established side of the AI-power trade that got damaged by the selloff while the fundamental business is intact.

calls.title: Massive News for Alphabet Stock and Constellation Energy Stock Investors | GOOG Stock | CEG Stock
calls.thesis: Google's $4.3B 20-year PPA for 890 MW + 15-yr 2.7 GW deal; updated DCF fair value $387 implies ~30% upside
calls.conviction: low - sees CEG as a commodity provider, can't yet identify the differentiator hyperscalers pay a premium for
calls.base: Forward P/E 22.5x ≈ its historical average since 2024; data-center power demand still outstripping supply
calls.bull: Big-5 hyperscaler capex $850B+ in 2026, rising further 2027-28; existing-site upgrades mean no greenfield build cost
calls.bear: Down 15% YTD even after the pop; stock up 691% over 5 years; undifferentiated vs Vistra and other nuclear suppliers
